name: Batch 22 · Hooks, voices and bounce
status: Published to separate Spotify audition and atomically appended to hosted Playlist Lab. Fifteen exact unrated candidates, prior feedback/history preservation and unchanged main Spotify orders verified.

selection_policy.authorization: Host requests another batch, 15 this time. Both remaining Likes and targeted discovery authorized. No predictive model.
selection_policy.method: Editorial selection using all 128 canonical Grove Keeps and 849 Cuts, including one new Keep and three explicitly close Cuts. Exact recording exclusions, full published song text, specific Keep/Cut comparisons, distinct lead artists; no inferred vote reasons or genre quotas.
selection_policy.brief: Upbeat, interesting, bouncy, melodic, sexy, fun, happy, hopeful and loving; personality, strong hooks and development. No acid/techno, chart-pop/top-five-hit character, sad/negative narrative, blandness, dragging repetition or standalone fragments. Existing individual Keeps remain approved.
selection_policy.evidence_limit: Direct audio input unsupported. Musical fit and perceived development remain editorial hypotheses. Full text review is not exact-master transcription; metadata/provider matches are not listening or playback proofs.

feedback_basis.policy: Canonical shared feedback resolves host priority; preserve individual histories
feedback_basis.grove_21: Lone Digger Keep; Hey Cowboy, Lets Go and The Golden Age remain Cuts explicitly described as very close. No exact failure reasons supplied.
